name: Agomelatine
effects: MT1/MT2 melatonin agonist + 5-HT2C antagonist — unique non-monoamine-reuptake mechanism
Resynchronizes circadian rhythm — take at bedtime
Not approved in the US (approved in EU, Australia); available off-label via compounding or import
Hepatotoxicity risk — LFT monitoring required at baseline, 6, 12, 24 weeks
Minimal sexual dysfunction, weight-neutral, no discontinuation syndrome
No serotonin syndrome risk (no SERT inhibition)
Extensively metabolized by CYP1A2 — contraindicated with fluvoxamine
